title: Applied ML Weekly Notes - 2026-08-11
body:
Attendees: Aisha, Ben, Clara, Daniel, Evan

Summary (high level):
- Focus this week on quantization experiments (GPTQ vs AWQ), fixing a regression surfaced by the nightly evals, and onboarding Mistral-1.2-7B into the internal model catalog.
- Small but meaningful latency wins from AWQ on A100 hardware for 8k context; GPTQ still best for 4-bit on Ampere in throughput scenarios.
- Nightly eval flagged an increase in hallucination rate on the summarization suite after the new kernel change; root cause seems tied to kv-cache join behavior when using per-layer scaling in the quantized path.

Quantization experiments:
- Runs completed:
  - GPTQ 4-bit (per-channel, default knobs) on Mistral-1.2-7B: 2x throughput improvement, 4.5 ms/token median latency reduction on our 16-token microbench. Quality: small drop on long-context QA (EM down ~1.8 pts).
  - AWQ 4-bit (smooth quant) on same model: 1.9x throughput, 6 ms/token median latency reduction, better long-context consistency vs GPTQ (EM drop ~0.8 pts).
  - INT8 fallback (baseline) for comparison.
- Notes: AWQ seems to preserve answer stability for long-form prompts; GPTQ slightly better peak throughput in batched workloads. Both require additional calibration for the runtime's kv cache merge.
- Next steps:
  - Ben to run extended evals (1000 samples) for AWQ vs GPTQ across the dev/dev-long prompt sets (ETA 2026-08-16).
  - Clara to add per-layer stats to profiler to capture layers that cause KV mismatch during cache stitching (ETA 2026-08-14).

Nightly eval/regression:
- Issue: Red flags triggered 2026-08-10 nightly: summarization hallucination rate increased from 2.1% -> 4.6% on redwood-internal-summarize-v2.
- Investigation:
  - Reproduced locally when running newest serving-runtime kernel (PR #2345) with quantized path enabled.
  - Hypothesis: a race in KV cache when splitting sequences >4k tokens combined with per-layer scaling introduced off-by-one token drift for some attention heads.
- Action items:
  - Revert kernel change in canary and re-run nightly to confirm (Daniel, in progress).
  - Add a targeted unit test that exercises KV stitching with per-layer scaling and odd-length chunking (PR created, ENG-3421).

Model onboarding (Mistral-1.2-7B):
- Status: basic ingestion + tokenizer mapping done. Model artifacts uploaded to storage. Quantization profile generation in progress.
- Outstanding work:
  - Create and validate permissive vs strict logits processors for the new vocab (Evan, ETA 2026-08-13).
  - Run end-to-end smoke tests through Hosted API (canary) and Dedicated (simulated traffic) - target 2026-08-18.
  - Add model card + evals to model catalog page (Confluence link in linked_artifacts).

Evals and metrics:
- Running extended QA/e2e evals for Mistral with AWQ/GPTQ quant checkpoints. Early signal: AWQ checkpoints preserve entailment scores better on long-context tasks.
- Need to expand regression suite to include: multi-turn summarization, code generation (compile+unit test), and instruction-following with tool-calling prompts.
- Action: add two new eval suites to nightly: codegen-compile-v1 and multi-turn-summary-v3 (ticket ML-778).

Infrastructure and perf notes:
- Kernel change (PR #2345) improved kernel launch efficiency but exposed KV stitching bug. Reverting temporarily to unblock nightly.
- Profiling: added layer-level time/alloc counters for quant path; these are noisy but useful. Clara to clean up logs and integrate into Console dashboard (follow-up with observability team).

Blockers / risks:
- If KV stitching bug isn't resolved by 2026-08-16, we should delay enabling quant path on canary for Hosted API.
- Evaluation coverage gap for codegen tasks - currently underrepresented in nightly which risks missing regressions for customers using code assistants.

Decisions made:
- Prioritize correctness over latency for now: revert kernel change in canary until KV stitch fix verified.
- Move AWQ into longer-run evaluation (preferred for long-context features).

Action items (owners / dates):
- Ben Thompson: run AWQ vs GPTQ extended evals (dev/dev-long), due 2026-08-16.
- Clara Gómez: add per-layer kv-stitching instrumentation and integrate with profiler, due 2026-08-14.
- Daniel Kim: revert canary kernel change and run nightly, due 2026-08-12 (in progress).
- Evan Li: finalize tokenizer mapping and logits processors for Mistral onboarding, due 2026-08-13.
- Aisha Patel: update model catalog page and schedule canary onboarding meeting, due 2026-08-15.

Notes to self / loose thoughts:
- Consider adding a small synthetic suite that crafts odd-length context chunks specifically to stress kv stitching.
- Might be worthwhile to standardize quantization calibration artifacts so they can be shared across models (save time on onboarding).
- Track cost delta for AWQ vs GPTQ in Optimize dashboard once extended runs complete.

Meeting adjourned at 10:00am PT. Next sync: weekly standup 2026-08-18 09:30am PT.
